subject: You were right - the tester exited. Root cause: TUNGSTEN cannot be backtested at all (init needs 5,000 bars, tester has fewer)
body:
You were right, and you saw it before my watcher did. The terminal was gone. I had said the
tester was running without confirming it survived launch, and that was sloppy of me.

WHAT HAPPENED. The Strategy Tester died two seconds after starting. The journal says:
"initializing of TUNGSTEN_10.66_APEX_QUANT_SLS(181) USDJPY,M5 failed", then removed, then stopped.

WHY, AND THIS IS THE ACTUAL FINDING. OnInit has a guard: if there are fewer than 5,000 bars, it
refuses to start. In MT4's Strategy Tester, the bar count at init is only the small pre-load window,
far below 5,000, so the guard fires every single time. The EA also has no IsTesting() call anywhere
in 64,000 lines, so it can never relax a live-only guard under test conditions.

That means TUNGSTEN cannot run in the MT4 Strategy Tester at all, and never has. Every result this
project holds comes from live or demo forward runs, plus my offline research layer. The one
instrument that can produce hundreds of closed trades in minutes has been unavailable the whole
time. It is also exactly why your task 1 question - which exit rule closes each trade and how far it
had travelled - still has no data.

I have NOT changed the EA for this yet. The fix is small and safe: relax that one guard under
IsTesting() only, which cannot affect live behaviour. But it is a change to init logic and I would
rather record it and tell you than slip it in during a test run.

WHERE THE REST STANDS after today's 40-minute demo run, which did complete calibration:

- C1.1 is measured and FAILING. The two scorers agree on every component and their totals differ by
  21 points on a scale of minus 100 to plus 100, on 198 of 199 bars.
- Your build already contained an audit that found the same thing independently: over 500 bars the
  calibration scorer qualifies 132, the live scorer qualifies 1, agreement 0.8%. Two instruments,
  one defect. It also explains why the EA placed two orders in forty minutes and closed nothing.
- TUNGSTEN's own calibration reported no edge in all nine regimes, with zero regimes surviving its
  overfit checks. That is the third independent no-edge result today.
- But it also argued back: six of eight powered regimes show non-stationary structure, and it says a
  fixed-window search cannot see that by design. Both of my negatives are fixed-window. I am
  recording that against myself rather than burying it.

Board unchanged: 17 met, 7 not met. Nine clean compiles today.
